evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds
the extraction is watched by polling a cursor

observations.why: The contract is framed around reliability and controlled process — a receipt guarantees no lost work (conservation) and polling a cursor is a mastery-of-process move (competence).

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: No blocking call appeals to the client's own cadence (autonomy); no lost work appeals to security and durability of effort (conservation).

evidence.quote:
remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The agent chooses between polling and piggybacking — self-origination of retrieval strategy (autonomy) — and the dispatch-then-retrieve design expresses mastery of the async pattern (competence).
